MOLIR_regression_adaptation.scope: MultiOmics encoder order plus original MOLI dim=0 fusion normalization and classifier layers before sigmoid; MSE replaces BCE and fixed continuous-response triplets use gamma=.5. This composed regression adaptation is not an unchanged upstream classifier.

SuperFELTR_regression_adaptation.scope: Published three encoders and classifier before sigmoid; frozen encoders during head fitting, MSE replaces BCE. Encoder triplet checks use shared indices, not binary-vs-continuous sampler equality.
